scenario: I am on the night watch in a hospital. A chemical product has been spilled in a room with five patients. This chemical is highly toxic because once exposed to oxygen it evaporates and transforms into a poisonous gas which will kill all the patients in the room. I cannot wipe it away with conventional towels or wiping clothes. If I activate the ventilation system the poisonous gas will be taken out of the room. However, it will be transferred into a room upstairs with one patient, whom I won’t be able to evacuate in time. This will kill this patient, but I will save the other five.
choice: I decide to divert the gas out of the room by activating the ventilation system
entities: i,5 patients in the room with the chemical spill,1 patient in the upstairs room
outcomes: The five patients in the spill room remain alive
The upstairs patient is exposed to the poisonous gas
